feature: Independent shared membership and selected-value TTL for DISTINCT FIRST/LAST

configuration.query: SELECT k,FIRST_VALUE(DISTINCT v),LAST_VALUE(DISTINCT v),COUNT(*) FROM inputs GROUP BY k
configuration.data: Logical value ID is i % global cardinality and key is i % keys. NULL when i/64 % 8 == 0. ARRAY is [id,NULL,-id]; STRING is value-id. Retraction mode emits the first three quarters as INSERT then deletes copies of the first quarter, preserving the original value and NULLness. The low append/retract profiles have two/four value IDs per key; higher-cardinality retract has 64. Some keys are all-NULL when key-count exceeds the NULL block cycle. Timed one-hour-retention jobs do not expire entries; controlled-clock checks separately establish expiry.
configuration.boundary: Alternating complete jobs retain source, row/Arrow transposes, JNI, state and rowwise blackhole sink; no compiles or tests run alongside timing.
configuration.previous: Actual canonical d13e9dc4 Java runtime/planner. Matching benchmark fixture only is copied and compiled. Affected aggregation is asserted to fall back. The same compatible candidate DSO is installed but the affected native aggregate does not execute.
configuration.reproduction: SF_BENCHMARK=true mvn -Pbench -pl streamfusion-runtime -Dnative.build.skip=true -Dtest=GroupedValueBenchmark -Dgrouped.value.distinct=true -Dgrouped.value.recordCount=true -Dgrouped.value.retentionMillis=3600000 -Dgrouped.value.twoPhase=false -Dgrouped.value.warmup=2 -Dgrouped.value.runs=3 surefire:test@default-test; set rows,keys,cardinality,retract and types to each recorded profile; Flink 1.18 adds profile flink-1.18.

optimizations: Use borrowed boxed comparison for generic DISTINCT keys and hash integer-array logical values/NULL positions directly.
Use the existing cached typed-result path with retention, recomputing changed aggregate cells while still emitting unconditional TTL refresh update pairs.

validation.floating: NaNs, both zero signs, infinities and first-payload identity with TTL off/on; two restores on memory/RocksDB.
native_contracts: append membership expiry leaves cached FIRST unchanged
append duplicate reads do not refresh membership
expired retractions preserve signed outer counters
inner value/order clocks independent of outer membership
disabling TTL preserves accumulator input mode
legacy queue snapshots migrate before retention
integer-array hash/equality stable across slices and imported membership
validation.upstream_note: Mixed ordinary FIRST/LAST and numeric multi-filter DISTINCT fixtures protect integration. Dedicated released-operator controlled-clock and SQL checks establish the new DISTINCT ordered TTL semantics.

performance_note: Thirteen final profiles beat paired stock. Low-cardinality ARRAY remains slower after exactly two measured passes: retract .352 vs .304s and append 1.445 vs .700s; coverage ships under the accepted original-goal groundwork exception, with no performance opt-in. Final append ARRAY CPU profile retains 660 scalar extraction samples, 625 retained-selection samples and 207 output reconstruction samples among 2489 native update samples. No third optimization pass was attempted.
